Current-source assessment 2026-09-12:
Retain P2 core-performance. SurfaceWorldLink.nearestVertex still scans every vertex and calls worldPoint for every candidate. worldPoint constructs a local point/vector, applies surfaceToWorld and wraps the transformed point. The existing linked-selection test covers translation and distance rejection; it does not establish the full original scale/shear/tie/index-reuse contract or current benchmark crossover.

The ownership premise requires correction: current build has no mesh4s dependency, and current SurfaceGeometry uses ScalaFIM TriangleMesh with image4s Affine. TriangleMesh exposes mutable Array[Double] coordinates and Array[Int] faceIndices. A cache keyed only by the same mesh/geometry object can therefore return stale coordinates after mutation. Exact topology equality is not coordinate identity either. Do not import the historical SurfaceRealization/mesh4s assumptions as facts about current main.

Before implementation, define a prepared immutable world-coordinate snapshot or enforce explicit coordinate/transform revision and invalidation; do not require an O(V) content hash on every query and then call the query sublinear. Make the query's ownership and snapshot lifetime visible rather than silently serving an old index for a mutable geometry. A generic indexing primitive should follow the current provider boundary and a concrete capability requirement; adopting mesh4s is not a prerequisite.

Keep the original exact world-distance/indexing objective and differential tests. Include mutation/replacement cases, equal-topology/different-coordinate cases, deterministic ties, boundary-radius inclusion and nonuniform transforms, with independent known landmarks as well as the brute-force baseline. Compare index setup, retained memory and warm queries to a primitive allocation-disciplined scan to report the actual crossover; distinguish synthetic mesh cardinalities from provenance-identified anatomical fixtures. Do not claim the historical scale labels or costs are current measurements. No algorithm change, runtime performance reproduction or test execution is completed by this source assessment.
